title: Falafel Recipe | The Best Raw Vegan Falafel Balls

freaking RW and falafal quite possibly the best rawan flaf balls out there you ready for it here we I all right so let you know this recipe is from my TR Retreat treats book and if you want a free equipment we're going to need for this so right now I would recommend the Excalibur dehydrator you need a dehydrator for this unless you want to serve some soggy balls I mean soggy Falafel balls you don't want to serve soggy Falafel balls I like to use a food processor to make the balls if you do not have a food processor you can also use a grater the recipe is divided into two portions dry and wet ingredients for the wet ingredients I recommend the Vitamix blender it's an amazing blender you can actually get one right here with free shipping I highly encourage you 7-year warranty best blender in the business but those are the things we need besides some measuring cups maybe a spoon and your hands to form the balls let's get into the all right so this recipe actually starts one or 2 days before you want to serve it and not for a lot of it but just for this we have a sixth cup of chickpeas dried chickpeas you're going to soak those in water for 12 hours and then give them at least one rinse every 12 hours you can Sprout them as much as you want so that will turn into this much once they've been soaked and sprouted for about 12 hours all right so for the dry crumble portion ingredients you will need4 cup raw walnuts dry or fresh cilantro oregano and parsley to taste two green onions a thir of a cauliflower half a zucchini and one medium carrot and then for the wet ingredients you will need one half a zucchini a small lemon4 red onion 1/4 cup pumpkin seeds don't forget the sprad chickpeas and an optional 1/4 teaspoon of cumin and garlic if you wanted a little bit garlicky so I'm just going to chop up some of these ingredients just a nice rough chop and throw them in start with the hardier ingredients carot and the cauliflower and we'll give it a quick [Music] pulse so you got this beautiful pill like consistency put it in a bowl and then we'll add some walnuts we'll add those to the Bowl want to scrape out a little bit the zucchini you can either grate or put in the food processor if you're using in the food processor You' got to be extra careful cuz you don't want it just turn into mush going to add the zucchini with everything except for the white the green onion as well as parsley cilantro and oregano to taste let's check it out a little bit more beautiful pour that into the bowl scrape out this food processor cuz we're done with it all right so we have this beautiful dry or crumbled portion of the recipe it's ready for us now we're going to go into the wet portion of the recipe so we have the zucchini chop it up throw that into the trusty Vitamix we have the lemon we'll squirt that in there W right in the eyeball try and avoid that if you can we have the red onion as well as the bottoms of the white onion if you don't like onion you can omit it from the recipe another trick is to finely chop the green onion as well as the red onion and let it sit for about a half an hour that will dissipate the mustard oil and make it a lot less irritating to your digestive tract we'll put the sprouted chickpeas in there the pumpkin seeds and here we have the optional cumin and garlic all right and now we're ready to blend oh my God it smells so [Applause] good bless the Vitamix tamper all [Music] right mhm that's good all right get it all in there I'm so lazy I could use a spatula all right maybe I'll use one I want to get all of this stuff in here this is like the cement to the flaff ball mixture all right now all we have to do is mix this up once it's all mixed up take a bit into your hand just kind of balce it around your hand carefully handling the balls oh my God that's disgusting sorry about that so you you want these to be about pingpong or golf ball sized put them up the front and just keep rolling you don't want to squeeze them too much then the juice comes out and they become dry so you just kind of form them all right so this recipe makes between between 10 and 20 balls depending on how big you make them These are nice golf ball size they'll shrink down quite a bit we're going to throw them in the Excalibur dehydrator between 115 to 119 for 6 to 8 hours it's been about 4 and 1/2 5 hours and you got to take the ones from the front the Bottom's a little less done this has already been flipped so take ones from the front move them back these ones up here so switch them around turn them over switch them around turn them over put them back in until they're fully crispy all the way around another hour hour and a half ffos all right so the Falafel balls should be done o they look pretty darn perfect nice and crunchy smell delicious let's go put them on some Falla so here I got a nice cabbage leaf and I made a little bit of hummus some hot sauce and some taziki with some lettuce and tomatoes normally I put some cucumbers in there too but we'll just select a couple balls and there you have it fulla so if you like this recipe definitely click here to sign up below for my mailing
